items.body:
Pass thread persistence intent to attachment uploads

## Why

Attachment stores need to distinguish uploads from ephemeral threads, which intentionally skip durable persistence.

## What changed

Add `ephemeral` to `UploadRequest` and propagate the turn configuration through image preparation for messages, tool outputs, and history replay. Include the flag in debug output while keeping attachment bytes redacted.

## Testing

Extend the Guardian context-budget test to assert that a persistent Guardian uploads exactly one image with `ephemeral: false`. Update the attachment debug-output assertion to include the new field.
